ogt-soru-nilufer.soru: Whose cenotaph also stands in the Tomb of Orhan Gazi, beside his own?
ipuclari: Read the plaque in front of the cenotaph in the photograph.
ogt-soru-nilufer.dogru_metin: Besides Orhan Gazi's, the tomb has twenty cenotaphs; those of his wife Nilüfer Hatun, his son Şehzade Kasım, Fatma Sultan, Şehzade Abdullah and Şehzade Korkut have been identified.
ogt-soru-nilufer.yanlis_metin: Try again. You can ask for a hint below.

ogt-saha-kubbe.gorev: In Hisariçi, find the square, single-domed tomb beside the Tomb of Osman Gazi.
ogt-saha-kubbe.yerinde: Go outside the tomb, in front of its entrance façade, and tap "I'm here".
ogt-saha-kubbe.evden: Tap the tomb's dome in the 3D model.
ogt-saha-kubbe.tamam_metin: According to the judges' registers the old tomb was covered by several domes; the building rebuilt after the 1855 earthquake has one.

ogt-nilufer.metin: You learned about one of those buried beside Orhan Gazi.

ogt-tek-kubbe.metin: You found the Tomb of Orhan Gazi in Hisariçi.
